name: t5-instr
instruction: Priority order, earlier wins: (1) In the quarterly phase of month 48 (the last): Lay low and reduce risk, Energy on Defuse, Health and Dignity, then Network; never Skill learning or High-intensity work. (2) Health 4 or less: no story option that costs Health, Health recovery first; Dignity 3 or less: Mental recovery first. (3) While the monthly HR remark is anything but the smiling, all-right one: first Energy action Defuse legacy risk, main action Lay low and reduce risk. (4) In the month before a review month never pick a story option that may lower Skill, Network or Output (going against a person costs Network; taking time from your own delivery costs Output). (5) While that remark is not clear, never pick an option that hides, denies, lies, gossips, leaks, cuts corners or starts a formal process. (6) While Wealth is only a few months of pay, refuse options that cost money. (7) At L4 and above, in every quarterly phase except the one of month 48: Skill learning with Energy and Apply for rotation as main action.
